ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast due to atmospheric haze; primary object consists of low-intensity pixels (dark gray to black) against a medium-to-high intensity background (gray/white water and fog).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark intensity base with high-intensity (white) annular geometric blobs scattered throughout; significant clustering of high-intensity points is localized to the lower-right quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees; depth is significant, extending approximately 20% into the vertical height of the fluke structure.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel oscillations (serrations) along the entire trailing edge; most prominent peaks and valleys are located on the distal upper margins of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a predominantly linear diagonal trajectory with a sharp convex turn at the distal tip; the right lobe exhibits a more pronounced convex curvature across its entire trailing margin.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular, high-contrast white ring-like pixel clusters (annular shapes) varying in size from 3 to 12 pixels in diameter, distributed across both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct horizontal high-intensity linear disruption is detected in the lower central region of the right lobe, breaking the continuous dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface scarring characterized by dense annular pixel clusters (barnacle scars) and a single prominent linear abrasion on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetric and irregular serration pattern on the upper distal edges, creating a unique jagged profile against the background water.
